title: LOAN (LendingClub 2007-2010 educational subset)
note: Candidates are REAL applicants drawn at the 3rd/45th/85th/99th PD percentiles (not invented). Scored with the ratified 7-col benchmark. NOTE: three features (fico external score; int.rate, credit.policy prior-decision artifacts) are availability-flagged - this benchmark is NOT an origination-time model; the deployable application-time model is the 4-col origination-only variant (fico/int.rate/credit.policy removed). See AEGIS_RUN_LOAN.md G3/G4 (LC-orig).
